dispositionDefinitions.RUNTIME_DEFAULT: On the maintained production path; security/sufficiency authority still bounded by code.

dispositionDefinitions.EVALUATION_ONLY: Implemented as offline/benchmark helper, not part of admitted production answer path.
dispositionDefinitions.REJECTED: Experimental hypothesis rejected in a documented DEV comparison; do not auto-combine.
dispositionDefinitions.REQUIRES_CUTOVER: Existing code/experiment is useful but lacks a proven safe single-owner production cutover.
dispositionDefinitions.UNIMPLEMENTED_GATE: Missing verified end-to-end or external acceptance evidence.
